resources.string: Extract event details from this text: "$text". Today's date is $currentDateStr. Return JSON with these fields only: {"name": "event name", "date": "YYYYMMDD", "startTime": "HHMMSS", "endTime": "HHMMSS", "location": "location", "url": "url", "description": "description", "timezone": "IANA format or UTC offset or N/A"}. If year isn't specified, assume the nearest future date. If endTime isn't specified, estimate based on event type (meetings: 1h, viewings: 30m, concerts: 2-3h). Never return 'N/A' for date, startTime, or endTime fields.
